observations: High-back office chair with a mesh back and fabric seat.
The chair is wrapped in protective plastic on the seat, backrest, and armrests.
It features a five-star chrome-finished base with five casters.
The chair is photographed outdoors on a paved surface.
No brand names or model numbers are visible on the item in any photo.

claims.evidence: The gas lift cylinder is visible but the lever and function are not demonstrated.
The swivel mechanism is not shown in motion.

risks.risk: The gas lift may be failed or lose pressure when sat upon.
risks.proof: A video showing the height adjustment lever working and someone sitting on it without it sinking.

risks.risk: One or more casters may be jammed or broken.
risks.proof: A video of the chair being rolled across the floor.

risks.risk: The plastic wrapping may hide tears, stains, or mesh damage.
risks.proof: Photos of the chair with all protective plastic removed.

proof_requests: Video of the height adjustment lever being operated while someone is sitting in the chair.
Video of the chair rotating 360 degrees and being rolled on its casters.
Photos of the seat and backrest with the plastic wrapping removed.
response.reason: The item is clearly a high-back office chair. While mechanical functions are unverified, it can be priced at its worst case as a non-adjustable chair with potential cosmetic flaws under the plastic.
